name: Four-lane arterial improvement — US preliminary design (FHWA case study, PD)

metadata.name: Arterial Corridor Improvement (Illinois DOT case study analog)
metadata.description: Improvement to a four-lane suburban arterial road with signalised intersections, audited at preliminary design and existing-roads stages per the FHWA RSA Case Studies program.
metadata.scheme_summary: Signal timing and phasing revisions; auxiliary turn lanes at two intersections; revised pedestrian crossings; corridor rear-end collision pattern.
metadata.authority: Illinois Department of Transportation (case study analog)

project_information_package.value: Preliminary design report: four-lane arterial, ADT 22,000; auxiliary through-right turn lanes at Main St and Oak Ave; coordinated signal system.

design_drawings_current_phase.value: 60% plan set: intersection geometry sheets M1-M6, signal plans S1-S4.

crash_history.value: 36-month crash extract: rear-end cluster at Main St approach (9 collisions), single nighttime ped-bike incident near Oak Ave.

provenance.license: Public Domain (explicit ROSA-P rights metadata; 17 USC §105)
provenance.extractor: ORCH transformed FHWA-SA-06-017 Table 1 entry 'Illinois DOT: improvement to four-lane arterial road, preliminary design stage and existing roads' into a Project input set; findings language patterned on the case study's summary-of-key-findings structure.

expected_findings_baseline.scenario: Auxiliary turn-lane introduction changes deceleration expectations; existing rear-end cluster may migrate to the new taper location under high following-demand platooning.

statement.text: Check taper length and advance signing for the new turn lane against the recorded rear-end pattern at this approach.

assumptions.text: Crash extract reflects current signal coordination.

confidence.label: medium
confidence.basis: Pattern documented in case-study analog; geometry assumed typical.

expected_findings_baseline.rationale: ORCH-as-judge baseline derived from FHWA public-domain case studies; distinguishable from quoted evidence.
expected_findings_baseline.recommendation: Extend the northbound advance warning placement and verify taper storage length for design-year peak queues.

expected_findings_baseline.scenario: Nighttime ped-bike incident history at the crossing suggests lighting and conspicuity may be insufficient once volumes grow.

statement.text: Assess crossing lighting levels and marking retroreflectivity at the Oak Avenue pedestrian crossing.

expected_findings_baseline.rationale: VRU-focused baseline finding authored by ORCH from case-study patterns.
expected_findings_baseline.recommendation: Provide luminaire coverage over the crossing and upgrade to high-visibility markings.

notes: Tier-0 snapshot to be recorded from actual deterministic run; baseline findings are judge targets, not engine outputs. Grounded in FHWA-SA-06-017 via ROSA-P (PD).
